trailhead.label: By the church of St. Margareth in Montal, where the Bunkerweg leaves the village road (free car park at the church)

cautions: About 1.4 km on quiet lanes in and around Montal, where a car or tractor may pass: keep your dog on a short lead there.
One crossing of the Onach road (SP125) at about km 2.3: cross with care.
Farmed meadows line the lanes: St. Lorenzen keeps dogs off them in the growing season.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.By the church of St. Margareth in Montal: Vicino alla chiesa di Santa Margherita a Mantana, dove il Bunkerweg lascia la strada del paese (parcheggio gratuito alla chiesa)
textIt.About 1.4 km on quiet lanes in and aroun: Circa 1,4 km su stradine tranquille dentro e intorno a Mantana, dove può passare un’auto o un trattore: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.One crossing of the Onach road (SP125) a: Un attraversamento della strada per Onies (SP125) verso il km 2,3: attraversa con attenzione.
textIt.Farmed meadows line the lanes: St. Loren: Le stradine costeggiano prati coltivati: San Lorenzo di Sebato vieta ai cani di entrarci nella stagione vegetativa.
